name: Yuki-Onna — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Yuki-Onna from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Mythic Yuki-onna" but are not part of the Yuki-Onna entry, which is unchanged.

MYTHIC YUKI-ONNA CR 10/ MR4

XP 9,600
LE Medium undead (cold, incorporeal, mythic)
Init +8; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +17
Aura snowstorm (200 ft.)

DEFENSE

AC 26, touch 26, flat-footed 20 (+10 deflection, +4 Dex, +2 dodge)
hp 126 (9d8+86) regeneration 5 (fire)
Fort +9, Ref +7, Will +11
Defensive Abilities icy mirror, incorporeal; DR 5/epic; Immune cold, undead traits; SR 22
Weaknesses vulnerable to fire, snow dependency

OFFENSE

Speed fly 30 ft. (perfect)
Melee 2 touches +10 (4d6 cold plus chilling touch)
Special Attacks chilling touch, fascinating gaze
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 10th; concentration +22)

Constant—blur
3/day—cone of cold (DC 23), eyebite (comatose and panicked only, DC 24), ice storm

STATISTICS

Str —, Dex 18, Con —, Int 17, Wis 21, Cha
Base Atk +6; CMB +10 (+18 bull rush); CMD 27
Feats Combat Casting, Dodge, Improved Initiative, Mobility, Spring Attack

Languages Common
SQ astral thrust, change shape (Small humanoid child; alter self)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Astral Thrust (Su)

A yuki-onna is surprisingly adept at shoving creatures that displease her. Despite being incorporeal, the mythic yuki-onna can attempt bull rush combat maneuver checks against corporeal creatures.

Additionally, the mythic yuki-onna receives a +8 bonus to bull rush combat maneuver checks and never provokes an attack of opportunity while doing so.

Chilling Touch (Su)

A yuki-onna’s touch causes 4d6 cold damage.
